verdict.rationale: Expensify's own travel product supports booking flights, hotels, cars and rail, and is marketed as ensuring "business trips don't end in a pile of receipts." That implies trip spend flows into expense handling. The pack never says bookings, card transactions and SmartScanned receipts are grouped automatically into a single report tied to an itinerary. Missing for 10: documented automatic trip-based grouping of bookings, card charges and receipts, an itinerary-linked report object, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
